purpose: Independent mechanism evidence added during over-acquisition wave. These records support re-review; they do not themselves promote a mechanism.

entries.evidence: Active seal-less vacuum venting experimentally compared with passive/no venting using in-mould sensing and short-shot analysis; reported burn-mark elimination, >60% sink-depth reduction, 23% cycle-time reduction and 15% energy reduction.
NRV wear state was evaluated online and V/P switchover compensation improved part-weight consistency.
Four non-return valves with different outer diameters were used to quantify wear effects on process variables, melt backflow and product quality.
Commercial PA6, POM and flexible-PVC batches were moulded under constant conditions while melt pressure, melt temperature and viscosity-index signals were monitored for batch variation.
2026 PP experiment links higher melt temperature to chain scission/high-MW loss, lower ductility and increased shrinkage using rheology, DSC/TGA and dimensional/mechanical measurements.
Silbione 4370 experiments quantify anisotropic shrinkage against flow/cross-flow direction and cure/thermal-history process variables.
Two-component Arburg process combines ABS and LSR with separate cavities and dynamic thermal management, providing direct thermoplastic/thermoset 2K evidence.
Fraunhofer project uses integrated pressure sensing to detect recyclate flow-property variation and control core-material position/breakthrough in 2K hot-runner moulding.
Three pressure positions along an ultra-thin micro-mould flow path were synchronised to injection start and repeated over 35 consecutive shots under fixed settings.
CF-PEEK overmoulded onto continuous CF-LM-PAEK includes pull-off load-extension curves, specimen position and microscopy/failure modes, enabling local interface-quality analysis versus gate distance.
